title: Remove or integrate dead adjust_biomes_for_season from field.py
details: adjust_biomes_for_season() is defined in field.py but never called anywhere. Either wire it into the seasonal update path or remove it. Document decision in AGENT_CHECK.md.
notes: Removed dead adjust_biomes_for_season() method from field.py (59 lines including docstring). Method was never called; its docstring falsely claimed it was called from cell.py. Directly mutates self.data with hardcoded values, inconsistent with existing seasonal regen system. Biome system intact — self.biomes still used by _assign_biomes(), get_biome(), analyze_biome_distribution(). Decision documented in AGENT_CHECK.md.
